note:
Reviewed opposing identities: The opposing United States and Spanish naval forces are identified in the contemporary 8 May account. Winslow and the small Spanish armed vessels supply representative equipment; Machias is not individually depicted. This identity review preserves uncertainty in numbers and does not reuse the 11 May casualty account. Unavailable quantities stay empty, so these identities support an illustrative engagement rather than proportional forces.

Equipment review: Winslow supplies the United States torpedo-boat component; Spain receives a small steam-gunboat family analogy for the armed flotilla described in the contemporary 8 May account. Machias and the varied Spanish hulls are not individually reconstructed. This is the 8 May action, not Winslow’s better-known damaged withdrawal on 11 May.
